description.value: Tofino Resort + Marina is a 63-room waterfront resort situated on the working marina in the heart of Tofino on unceded Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation territory. The property anchors an on-site Adventure Centre offering whale watching, bear watching, kayaking, hot springs tours, guided fishing, a gym, and a marina, making it a full-service basecamp for West Coast exploration. Shelter Restaurant operates on-site, and the resort is within walking distance of Tofino's shops, cafés, and trailheads.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, operating resort at 634 Campbell Street, Tofino. The OSM name 'Sitka' refers to one of the resort's own buildings—the FAQ explicitly references 'the Sitka building, beside room 101'—while the actual business is Tofino Resort + Marina. Laundry facilities and an on-site restaurant (Shelter) are confirmed by website text; bike storage, bike procedures, Wi-Fi, and most other amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name 'Sitka' is the name of one building within the resort complex, not the business name. The FAQ explicitly refers to 'the Sitka building, beside room 101', while the brand tag and all website content use 'Tofino Resort + Marina' as the business name. The OSM record may benefit from a name correction to 'Tofino Resort + Marina'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable resort confirmed via active website with live reservation system. Useful to touring cyclists as a full-service accommodation base in Tofino.
